messages:
sam: quick heads-up  sample-app CI started failing typechecks after the python sdk bump. pyright errors around streaming return annotations and mypy shows model fields as Any from generated models.

ivy: can you paste one of the pyright errors?

sam: `Expression of type 'list[Item] | None' is not iterable` on `for x in resp.items:`. mypy: `Incompatible types (got Any, expected Item)` when building lists from parsed responses.

ravi: sounds like the codegen started emitting PEP 604 unions and we don't ship stubs, so static checkers lack field info. two possible fixes: emit .pyi stubs in-wheel, or publish a small redwood-types package.

ivy: prefer .pyi next to modules (CLI flag `--emit-pyi`) targeting py3.8 typing (`from typing import List, Optional`) to avoid list[] vs typing.List mismatches.

sam: streaming endpoints need overloads in pyi so `stream(parse=True)` types as `AsyncIterator[ModelDelta]` and default remains `AsyncIterator[bytes]`. example pyi overloads look like:
```python
@overload
def stream_events(..., parse: bool = False) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]: ...
@overload
def stream_events(..., parse: bool = True) -> AsyncIterator[EventDelta]: ...
```

ravi: watch forward refs and circular models: use stringified refs and `if TYPE_CHECKING:` imports in pyi. also add a tiny types smoke-test to sample-app CI (mypy+pyright) and include `py.typed` if embedding types.

ci-bot: CI failure: pyright check failed on branch sam/emit-pyi - https://ci.redwood.example/build/1420

ivy: I'll prototype the emitter and smoke test. sam will open a draft PR. cc @ravi for review once prototype is up. :thumbsup:
